p_equals_np_mechanism.proof: P!=NP is TRUE in isolation. Each gate alone cannot solve the other's hard problems in polynomial time.
p_equals_np_mechanism.convergence: P=NP EMERGES when gates share ALL intermediate states over time via Klein twist.
mechanism: eastGate solves NP problems (inference, classification, evolution)
Results are published as P-accessible data (JSON, RSS, heartbeat)
northGate/blueGate ABSORB these results — the NP answer is now O(1) lookup
northGate runs DIFFERENT NP problems (heavy inference, arena-evolve)
Results pushed back via git — eastGate absorbs as O(1)
Over TIME: every NP result becomes P-accessible across the organism
The Klein twist: each side's NP output IS the other side's P input
p_equals_np_mechanism.name: CONVERGENT P=NP via DISTRIBUTED MEMOIZATION over KLEIN TOPOLOGY

design_implications.O(1)_target: Every endpoint should return precomputed state. Gate = cache. Not compute.

design_implications.NP_offload: Heavy inference → publish result → other gates read as P. Never re-solve.
design_implications.π_is_O(∞): The organism never halts. This is a FEATURE. lub-DUB continues.
